title: fix(console): on a desktop the ⌘⇧H row names the app start page it opens, not the retired home
body:
Fixes #37149

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：桌面端快捷键说明和应用切换菜单里，⌘⇧H 那一行从「返回首页」改为「返回应用起始页」；手机端不变，快捷键本身的行为也不变。
- 为什么做：属于「首页退役」收尾工作的最后一项，平台首页已经下线，这一行还在承诺一个不存在的首页。
- 出错会怎样：最坏只是这一行文案读起来别扭，不影响跳转；改动只涉及文案与一行显示逻辑，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Measured first (code read at `origin/main` 1f3e9f68e): `ConsoleLayout` installs `useGoHomeShortcut(true, useHomePath())`. From 768 px up `useHomePath()` answers `resolveDesktopHomePath(served, lastApp)` — the last-used app, else the declared default, else the first product app — the same answer `/` redirects a desktop to after #36732. Inside an app the last-used app is the app itself (`ConsoleLayout` calls `rememberApp(activeAppName)`), so on a desktop `⌘⇧H` opens the current app's start page; from Studio or the AI pages it opens the last-used app's start page. On a phone it still opens the declared landing or the app list at `/home`.

So the chord has a real, working destination on a desktop; only its NAME was stale. I kept the shortcut and retargeted the wording rather than retiring it — retiring would remove a working key users may rely on, which the dispatch reserved as a product decision; renaming changes no behaviour.

- `chrome/advertisedShortcuts.ts`: `GO_HOME_SHORTCUT` stays the phone row (「Back to home」, `console.shortcuts.goHome`); new `GO_TO_APP_START_SHORTCUT`, the same id and chord, labelled with `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome` — the key the app pill's row already draws — so the dialog and the pill name one destination. Stale doc (it said `AppHeader` owns the listener) corrected.
- `chrome/goHomeShortcut.ts`: the handler is unchanged; it advertises the phone row below 768 px and the desktop row from 768 px up (`usePhoneViewport`).
- `layout/AppSwitcher.tsx`: module doc and the row's English default updated. The dropdown is desktop-only (a phone opens the app-list sheet, which has no such row); keycaps unchanged.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: value change only, no new key — `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome` in all eleven locales now reads 「Back to app start page」 (zh-Hans 返回应用起始页). That key has one reader, the desktop dropdown row (plus now the desktop dialog row). `console.shortcuts.goHome` is unchanged.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/goHomeShortcut.ts` — the viewport choice of which row to advertise (the only logic change).
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/advertisedShortcuts.ts` — the second advertised constant, same id and chord.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.homeMark-12605.test.tsx` — the new describe at the end.

Two-minute check: run the console at a desktop width inside any app, press `?` to open the keyboard-shortcuts dialog — the Navigation section lists 「Back to app start page ⌘⇧H」; open the app pill — the row reads the same with the same keycaps; press ⌘⇧H — you land on the app's start page. Narrow the window under 768 px and the dialog row reads 「Back to home」.

## Tests

Head `7c591386d`. Pins added as a top-level describe in the existing harness `AppHeader.homeMark-12605.test.tsx`, read through the real English catalogue:
- desktop (1280 px): the advertised ⌘⇧H row equals `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome` (the pill's words), equals 「Back to app start page」 and does not contain "home";
- CONTROL, phone (375 px): the row stays `console.shortcuts.goHome` 「Back to home」.
The switcher pins (`AppSwitcher.homeMenu-12605`, `AppSwitcher.hostSingleApp-12913`) now expect the new row text; the row's href and `⌘⇧H` keycaps assertions are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Desktop: the dialog row and the pill row both read 「Back to app start page」 with ⌘⇧H, and ⌘⇧H opens that page. Phone: unchanged (dialog row 「Back to home」, no dropdown row, same handler).
- Not changed here, outside this card: the pill's 「All apps」 row links to the same `useHomePath()` target as the row above it, so on a desktop it also opens the last-used app's start page rather than any list of apps; other 「Back to home」 surfaces (the not-found and access-denied states, the AI-unavailable page, the product mark's 「PRODUCT home」 name) likewise lead to that start page on a desktop. Reported to the seat as one family; not touched.
- Browser check: NOT MEASURED, reason: the destination was established by code read of `useHomePath` / `resolveDesktopHomePath` and is pinned in jsdom; no dev server was started.

## Verification

- Derived local gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 41 commands): all 41 exited 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 41 derived, 41 run, 0 UNRUN.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean (merges cleanly with origin/main and the three open PRs sharing locale files).
- E2E collection under CI's config (`cd ui && pnpm exec playwright test --project=chromium --list`): exit 0, 202 tests in 35 files; no spec names the changed row.
- CI families: in progress at open; the PR's check-runs are the verdict.
